scope: True normal-package installed user-service guided-up acceptance. Foreground native evidence cannot satisfy these cases; actual adapter and live work remain separately identified.
references: decentralized-runtime-contract.md sections 6 Native commands and guided setup, 9 Product/status/install, 10 Verification
guided-setup-proposal.md; apply current DEC runtime overrides to historical coordinator/invite behavior
required_offers: Parent provides exact normal Go/Rust package/installer hashes and supported native up artifacts
Legitimate separate owned users with working user-service managers and actual installed processes/sockets; no foreground daemon fallback
Explicit controlled integration/session/credential and adapter fixture from public contracts; no invented readiness/model result

cases.name: installed_up_fresh_create_uses_actual_service_and_no_coordinator
assert: Exact installed package binary and service unit/PID/socket are observed under owned user
Fresh explicit create uses current local original provider without inventing creator device consent or launching helper/coordinator
Service/profile/private files obey existing permissions and normal package behavior

cases.name: installed_up_pending_and_default_no_preserve_request_and_do_not_attach
assert: Explicit new link/join displays private code only at allowed owner TTY action
Automatic pending up resumes same request/person/host/device/review with no code redisplay
Both separate default-no consent declines exit incomplete; no new create/join request, person/key replacement, service-unit rewrite or agent attachment
Final committed attempts are never recreated or cancelled as unsigned

cases.name: installed_up_rejects_explicit_profile_conflict_before_trust_or_enrollment
assert: Known explicit incompatible profile settings refuse before trust/enrollment/signing/key writes
Omitted expiry inherits saved immutable profile expiry
Existing credentials, scopes, session, connection and service remain intact

cases.name: installed_up_attaches_only_after_linked_and_actual_provider_service_gates
assert: Actual local link application plus currently usable selected provider is required before attachment
Actual installed service and public credential/session/connection are independently verified
Observe actual adapter readiness handshake separately; link/transport success alone cannot claim adapter_ready/model availability or live task output

cases.name: installed_up_ready_reuse_and_offline_recovery_preserve_attachment
assert: Ready attached reuse skips duplicate launch and preserves same session/scopes/credential
Offline recoverable state preserves attachment and reports incomplete launch unless explicit no-start is selected
Nonempty harness arguments are not silently discarded on reuse-without-launch

cases.name: installed_up_authority_repair_preserves_identity_profile_and_credentials
assert: Pending/expired/forked/migration authority reports exact repair/next action for retained identities
No original fallback, identity replacement, duplicate attachment or inferred freshness/readiness
Service/profile/credentials and completed signed operation history are preserved; never lower authority guard

measurement: Report each language pairing and installed artifact separately, exact unexecuted prerequisites, actual service/adapter observations and retained failures. Do not combine foreground/native, reference relay, installed and live-agent receipts into a final-head aggregate.
stop_rule: No execution until parent supplies coherent reviewed installed artifacts and legitimate service fixtures. Freeze actual executable cases before runtime; retain first failures and run only failed/unevaluated continuations.
